description: KAIRO's other windows (kairo-*: outputs, their hidden capture windows, Monitor, Identify) — only what their pages use: the server token, showing themselves and going full screen, reporting a change to capture (an NDI/Syphon/DeckLink output's capture window) and handing a full-frame video background to the app. Nothing else of the main window's (window creation, updates, outputs, clipboard): a slide or theme shown there can't reach those.
